comment: Bench arms for bench/run.py. One entry per measurable arm; adding a backend is an entry here and no code change. requires: [] = offline/in-process, 'llama-server' = a live llama.cpp at the arm's endpoint (asserted via /props before any probe traffic), 'hosted' = a hosted API whose key must be in the environment. expect_model is the gguf basename the server must be serving; when it is empty the run refuses unless --expect-model names one, because an unasserted lane is how a stale server got measured as a different model (docs/model-sweep-consolidated.md, CORRECTION). override holds dotted conf paths applied before the backend is built, which is how a variant becomes a named arm instead of a flag nobody recorded.

fixture.comment: Recorded-decision replay: deterministic, model-free, what selftest runs.

heuristic.comment: The regex pre-gate, scored standalone. Abstains on most rows; that is the coverage gate, not a weak classifier.

logit_read.comment: The Jev-style letter read this lane uses to score any gguf, so the model is not implied by the arm: pass --expect-model with the basename the lane was served.

pair.comment: stage1 local + stage2 hosted. Needs the key: without it the pair degrades to stage1 only, which is a different arm.

pair_tau085.comment: The 'enable the local model' variant: a lower tau escalates more, so more rows pay both stages.

openrouter.comment: Hosted-only. One key, one provider pin; both come from decide.openrouter.
